    • testPerformEditMapInvalidCommand

      public void testPerformEditMapInvalidCommand() throws IOException, InvalidCommand, InvalidMap
      Tests the behavior of the performEditMap method when an invalid command is given.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs.
      InvalidCommand - If the command is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map is invalid.

    • testPerformEditContinentInvalidCommand

      public void testPerformEditContinentInvalidCommand() throws IOException, InvalidCommand, InvalidMap
      Tests the behavior of the performEditContinent method when an invalid command is given. It checks if the log message indicates that continent editing is not possible without editing the map first.
      Throws:
      InvalidCommand - If the command is invalid.
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs.
      InvalidMap - If the map is invalid.

    • testPerformEditContinentValidCommand

      public void testPerformEditContinentValidCommand() throws IOException, InvalidCommand, InvalidMap
      Tests the behavior of the performEditContinent method when valid commands are given. It verifies if continents can be added and removed successfully, and if the state is updated accordingly.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs.
      InvalidCommand - If the command is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map is invalid.

    • testPerformSaveMapInvalidCommand

      public void testPerformSaveMapInvalidCommand() throws InvalidCommand, InvalidMap, IOException
      Tests the behavior of the performSaveMap method when an invalid command is given. It checks if the log message indicates that no map was found to save.
      Throws:
      InvalidCommand - If the command is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map is invalid.
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs.

      public void testAssignCountriesInvalidCommand() throws IOException, InvalidCommand, InvalidMap

      InvalidCommand - If the command is invalid.
      InvalidMap - If the map is invalid.
